title: Disabled Vanilla Recipes by Azturax
description: This Datapack disables all Vanilla recipes and Advancements!
body:
No Vanilla Recipes 

Total crafting blackout. Your tech progression starts from zero.

This single-file datapack uses pack.mcmeta namespace filtering to permanently disable 100% of vanilla Minecraft recipes—no crafting table spam, no golden apples, no stone tools. Clean slate for survival.

What gets nuked
 
 
✅ All crafting recipes (shaped/shapeless)

✅ Smelting/furnace recipes

✅ Smithing/stonecutting

✅ Brewing/everything craftable

 
❌ Your mod recipes stay untouched
